svg.title: Varroa evidence atlas — All curated evidence
svg.desc: Filtered occurrence records. Symbol locations and coordinates are unchanged. Equal ring segments indicate groups present, not frequencies. Current geographic viewport; filters are recorded in metadata.

g.text: Matching evidence: 142 coordinate pairs · 182 point records · 120 country records
Filled: published coordinates Hollow: approximate Number: shared records Gold halo: added 2026 Gray halo: genome evidence
Circles: V. destructor Diamonds: V. jacobsoni Squares: V. underwoodi Triangles: V. rindereri Stars: unresolved species
Counts include all matching records; only locations in the current map extent are shown. Rings do not encode sample proportions.
Occurrence evidence; neither prevalence nor continuous ranges. Filters:
Resource: Traynor et al. (2020), doi:10.1016/j.pt.2020.04.004 · Cite the selected source studies separately.
